## User need

Who benefits, and what decision becomes easier?

## Proposed outcome

Describe observable behavior rather than a preferred implementation.

## Evidence requirements

List the required geography, period, metrics, and official sources.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Define a testable outcome.
- [ ] Document scoring or RAG implications.
